q: The Böttcher coordinate near an attracting fixed point 0 of f(z) = λz + … with |λ| < 1 linearizes f to:
exp: Koenigs linearization theorem: near an attracting fixed point with multiplier λ (0 < |λ| < 1), f is locally analytically conjugate to z ↦ λz. (Böttcher coordinates apply near superattracting fixed points.)
